about-me-section.text1: Hi, I'm Marco - Freelance Frontend Developer from Düsseldorf, specialized in WordPress websites and custom web applications. I work with small and medium-sized businesses to bring their digital projects to life - whether it's a new website, shop integration, or custom web tools.
about-me-section.text2: My focus is on robust WordPress, TypeScript/Angular for complex frontends, and intelligent automation with n8n.
about-me-section.text3: Always with the goal: solutions that work, are maintainable, and drive your business forward.

my-stack-section.text: I develop modern and responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Angular. I focus on writing clean code, use Git and GitHub for version control, and quickly and enthusiastically learn new tools and technologies.
my-stack-section.peel-two: Also, I'm interested in diving into:

my-craft-section.text: I love turning ideas into functioning websites and web applications. Here you'll see both my custom development projects and WordPress solutions for clients - all built with modern, responsive design and clean, maintainable code. It's important to me that applications not only work technically, but also feel intuitive to users. Feel free to explore, try everything out - and if you have any feedback, I'd love to hear it!

my-craft-section.el-pollo-loco: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
my-craft-section.da-bubble: This App is a Slack Clone App. It revolutionizes team communication and collaboration with its intuitive interface, real-time messaging, and robust channel organization.

join.title: Join
join.text-one: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
join.text-two: As a team, we developed a Kanban board, where I actively contributed and took responsibility for specific tasks – mainly in the front-end area. Using agile methods, I was able to work in a structured and independent way while collaborating closely with the team.

el-pollo-loco.title: El Pollo Loco
el-pollo-loco.text-one: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
el-pollo-loco.text-two: „El Pollo Loco“  is a browser-based jump'n'run game that I developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The game logic is built in an object-oriented structure and uses the canvas element for rendering and animation. Enemies, level elements, and the player character interact through simple collision detection. All game components were fully implemented in vanilla JavaScript - completely without a game engine.

da-bubble.title: DABubble
da-bubble.text-one: This App is a Slack Clone App. It revolutionizes team communication and collaboration with its intuitive interface, real-time messaging, and robust channel organization.
da-bubble.text-two: DABubble is a collaboratively developed Slack clone, created as part of a team project at the Developer Akademie. The application allows user registration, channel-based communication, and real-time messaging. The goal is to independently recreate all core features of Slack - including a modern UI, authentication, and data handling.

pokedex.title: Pokedex
pokedex.text-one: A responsive, browser-based Pokédex that provides information about Pokémon using the public PokeAPI. Users can browse Pokémon cards, view detailed information, and explore their respective evolution chains.
pokedex.text-two: The application includes a searchable Pokémon database and offers dynamic detail views for each individual Pokémon. Key focuses were on achieving efficient API integration as well as designing an intuitive, flexible, and responsive user interface.

testimonial-section.card-one: Working on a project with you is a real pleasure. Your drive to do things exceptionally well is truly inspiring. You dedicate time to research and training, communicate clearly, and work reliably. What I appreciate most is your empathy — both professionally and personally, you’re a true asset to any team.
testimonial-section.card-two: Your determination and high standards of quality impress me every single time — and I truly mean that. You know exactly where you want to go, approach tasks with great structure and precision, and bring tremendous value to our project through your perfectionism and clear focus. Absolutely outstanding!
testimonial-section.card-three: I got to know Marco as a committed, helpful, and empathetic person. He works in a structured way, brings strong technical understanding, and always thinks in a solution-oriented manner. I especially value the respectful exchange at eye level and his willingness to share knowledge. Working with him was a real pleasure.

contact-section.text: I'm always open to new projects, ideas, and exciting challenges - especially when it comes to coding and finding creative solutions. If you're looking for someone who's passionate, eager to learn, and ready to be a real asset to your team, then you've come to the right place. Just drop me a message - I'm looking forward to hearing from you and hopefully creating something awesome together!
